Name: Shop Tile Framework
Author: CherryChain
Description:
[b][size=4][color=Red]⚠[/color] This mod is deprecated. It'll be kept updated to support older content packs, but newer mods should [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Shops]use the game's new built-in shop data[/url] instead.[/size][/b]


This mod lets content packs create fully customizable shops and animal shops (including support for custom behaviour or trade items), and make them interactable in-game via tile properties.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6529]Expanded Preconditions Utility[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use (for players)[/size][/b]
Just install this mod normally, and it'll work automatically for content packs that need it.


[b][size=5]How to use (for mod authors)[/size][/b]
You add shops by creating a Shop Tile Framework content pack, whose [font=Courier New]shops.json[/font] file contains the shop data to add.

See the [url=https://github.com/ChroniclerCherry/stardew-valley-mods/blob/develop/ShopTileFramework/docs/README.md]technical documentation[/url] for more info.

Some features include:
[list]
[*]Edit both vanilla and custom shops.
[*]Specify a shop currency (e.g. money, casino coins, festival score, or trade items). You can sell pants that cost 5 parsnips and 100 gold if you want!
[*]Make shops that sell animals, optionally with a stock limit! You can also optionally remove animals from Marnie's shop, so they're exclusively available at your custom shop.
[*]Randomized stock and conditions, which let you change the shop stock each day. You can fully control when items are available, rotate items, check conditions, etc.
[*]Customizable shop opening hours.
[*]Support for items from Json Assets. You can safely add optional items/animals to your shop without enforcing a hard dependency on Json Assets; if that mod isn't installed, Shop Tile Framework will just skip those items. You can optionally add an entire Json Asset pack to a shop instead of individual items, for easy maintenance.
[*]Json Assets items can be added directly to Shop Tile Framework shops from the Json Assets content pack.
[*]Open vanilla shops with tile properties (including special shops like Marnie's animals, Robin's buildings, and Clint's geodes).
[/list]

[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, the mod makes no changes to your save.[/quote]
